audit_items.proof_trace: PendingComponents.verified_blobs RuntimeFixedVector is sized to max_blobs_per_block(epoch) at creation (L580) via get_or_insert_mut. Cached entries persist across epoch boundaries where Fulu blob schedule increases max_blobs. New blobs with index >= old_max_blobs fail silently in insert_blob_at_index (L108: get_mut returns None), causing incomplete availability checks and consensus failures.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Create PendingComponents in epoch N with max_blobs=6. Cross epoch boundary to N+1 where blob schedule increases max_blobs=9. Submit block with 9 blobs. Blobs 6-8 fail to insert into cached vector (silent failure at L108), block incorrectly marked unavailable despite having all blobs, causing validator to reject valid block.
